content.rendered:
Convert AVIF to PNG With Full Transparency and Lossless Quality

AVIF is a cutting-edge image format with outstanding compression, but its newness means many applications and workflows still can’t read it. Converting AVIF to PNG gives you a universally supported, lossless file that opens in every editor and application — with full transparency preserved. This free converter runs entirely in your browser.

Why PNG Makes a Great Destination for AVIF

  • Universal support — every image editor, operating system, and application opens PNG without issue.
  • Transparency preserved — both formats support full alpha channels, so transparent pixels come through perfectly.
  • Lossless fidelity — PNG captures the exact output of the AVIF decoder, with no further quality loss.
  • Editing-friendly — PNG is ideal when you plan to manipulate the image further in Photoshop, GIMP, Figma, or similar tools.

How This Tool Converts AVIF to PNG

Your browser decodes the AVIF file natively (requires a modern browser — Chrome 85+, Firefox 113+, Safari 16.4+, or Edge), then the tool re-encodes the image as lossless PNG. Output is optionally optimized with oxipng, an open-source PNG compressor that finds the smallest possible lossless encoding without changing a single pixel.

About File Size

PNG output will be significantly larger than the AVIF source — typically 3–10x. AVIF is one of the most efficient formats ever designed, while PNG prioritizes lossless fidelity above all else. That’s the trade-off for compatibility and edit-friendliness. Use the Compression slider to let oxipng shave 10–40% off the PNG size without any quality loss.

Private & Offline

All conversion happens inside your browser using WebAssembly. Your AVIF files never leave your device. The tool works offline after the first page load and has no file size limits, no account requirements, no watermarks, and no usage caps.
